summary: Kent St (E) south of Druitt St: old City of Sydney counter 233 (2015-2025) had several multi-week zero outages (2019, 2021, Nov 2022-Aug 2023, and from May 2025 until it was retired), single-day feed-wide zero days, and about 20 days in 2022-2024 where every record was published twice; these are set missing or de-duplicated. The replacement counter 367 (from Oct 2025) reads about a third higher and is kept as separate series; it has one lost day on 2026-06-27.
